name: Kentucky
subtitle: Press break against a 1-3-1 press
goal: Attack one side with the dribble and make the left defender choose.
options: X steps up: pass to 4. X drops back: keep driving. Trapped: 5 in the middle, or back to 3.

steps.note: 1 drives straight up the court right away. 3 trails behind 1 so there is always a pass back. 2 stays near the middle, connected to the play.
At half court, 1 reads the defender in front. If X drops back, keep driving. If two defenders trap, 5 is open in the middle and 3 is behind.
If X steps up to stop the ball, 4 is open. 1 passes to 4: the press is beaten and we go into our half-court offense.
